thread:
Alex (Support): Customer reports when using streaming SSE with tool calls enabled the tool args JSON is being cut mid-body on resume after a keepalive/h2 window update. They get a schema parse error and the tool is skipped. Example seen in their logs: {"tool":"charge_inquiry","args":{"account_id":"acct_92...","range":"2024-01-01","filters":{"type":"payment","status":"com"}} <-- truncated
Priya (SRE): can you paste request-id, client SDK/version, whether through hosted API or Dedicated? any proxy in front?
Alex (Support): req_id=rid_20260317_9f8a, SDK=python-redwood/0.9.4, customer on hosted, traffic -> edge LB -> cloudflare. They repro with curl --no-buffer to /v1/streams. Log shows a chunk boundary at ~16384 bytes.
Marta (Eng): possible chunk-splitting on keepalive at the edge. @Priya can you check if gateway http2 window sizing or our sse-packer is inserting an extra CRLF that chops JSON?
Priya (SRE): on it. Also need the raw SSE stream sample (full event/data frames). Alex, ask customer to run: curl -v -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \\  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams -d '{"model":"gpt-4-redwood","input":"call_tool","toolings":true}' > sse_dump.txt
Alex (Support): forwarded command + their sse_dump (attached to ticket). Raw snippet from dump:
--DATA--
event: message
data: {"id":"tok_1","type":"toolcall","payload":{"tool":"charge_inquiry","args":{"account_id":"acct_92...","range":"2024-01-01","filters":{"type":"payment","status":"com"}


Note the missing closing braces and then a heartbeat event immediately after.
Raj (Support): customer sees 400 from our tool validation path; billing charged for request tokens but no tool executed — they're asking for refund.
Marta (Eng): repro plan: spin up a minimal TCP proxy that splits outgoing SSE stream at configurable byte boundary (test N=8192, 16384), reproduce keepalive/heartbeat interleaving, and confirm if our reassembly logic drops the trailing bytes. Also add test for tcp_nodelay/linger/keepalive toggles.
Priya (SRE): escalated to edge team, opening infra ticket INF-5238, tagging @edge-team for chunk-reassembly audit.
deploy-bot: INF-5238 created by Priya (SRE) - title: "SSE stream fragmentation: toolcall args truncated on keepalive/edge handoff"
Alex (Support): customer asks for workaround/timeline — any temporary mitigations?
Marta (Eng): recommend customer disable intermediate proxy keepalive trimming or switch to websocket streaming. For Dedicated customers, bump 'sse_chunk_size' in gateway config as a stopgap. We'll add a hotfix probe to edge that counts unmatched JSON opens vs closes to detect reassembly errors.
Priya (SRE): collecting pcap + edge logs now; will paste links in ticket when available. Alex, confirm we'll waive billing for the failed toolcalls while we investigate :thumbsup: 
Alex (Support): done, customer notified and CC'd. Will follow up once INF-5238 has updates.
